items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Later, who’d I work with? Tiny Grimes... It was Tiny Grimes and his Swinging Highlanders. So I had to wear the kilts.

ctx.x: He says, “You’re back for more. Okay. I’ll give it to you.” But I learned so much from him. Oh yeah. That guy, Mr. Carroll. He was so stiff, when he’d tell a joke, you’d have to try to figure out, was it really a joke. He was so stiff. That’s really the only thing that – psychology and some of those other classes – oh, and the only class I ever failed, R.O.T.C. – Reserve Officers Training Corps. We had to go out with – we had our uniforms. We got map reading, rifle range, marching. I said, I’m music. I’m not…

drinks over. The guy said, “You got to wear a bathing suit, a tight bathing suit. You can’t go out like that.” I didn’t know. They got me the first night. Then I thought I was going to be a nervous wreck in that band. He used to play with Art Tatum. He was playing certain tunes, but we didn’t know what key the tunes were going to be in. Whatever key he felt, that’s what the tune was, and we never knew. He would alway give us a little intro, de-din-din, de-din, to let us know what key it’s going to be in.…

items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Benny Golson is from Philly, and Roy Bryant is from Philly.

ctx.x: Oh, Now you're talkin' entertainment, these guys -- well that's what they need, They need something and they really appreciate it. It's no problem. Everything is nice, you know. You can even get to hang out to a certain extent. I know quite a few fellas up there, you know. So, I'll be glad to do it. I got the personnel, it's just a matter of what the date is going be. I don't even know what the name of the prison -- I think it's Raybrook.
So, you said you played in Cleveland for a while, and then you went to Detroit and traveled around a bit -- Canada -- but you did end up in Philadelphia for quite some time too.
Oh yeah, well I was in Chicago, too, for a while, and when I hit Philadelphia --
